notes: At tile_ft 25 a tile is 25 x 304.8 = 7620 mm. footprint_mm 7620.00000000000000001 (21 significant digits) is 1e-17 mm over one tile, so ceil(7620.00000000000000001 / 7620) = 2 and the house spans 2 x 1 tiles, not the declared 1 x 1. Read as a binary double the width is 7620.0 exactly and the footprint would wrongly agree.
